The overall petrichor smell however is much more than just mold. It includes plant oils that are volatilized by the rain, bacteria, and other microorganisms or their byproducts. Even older materials can harbor smells that get activated when it rains, especially if they’ve been damp before. It’s also worth considering the gutters and downspouts; if they’re clogged or not functioning properly, water can build up and create a breeding ground for mold.
